task.title: Publish the desktop app from this repository's releases
task.description:
Cut desktop builds from this repository, and retire the one they come from today.

Depends on CI: a release path that publishes what nothing verified is worse than no release path.

## One version, two tag namespaces

The version is this repository's. The namespaces exist so either artifact can be cut without forcing the other.

| Tag | Builds | Changes today |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `v0.5.2` | CLI archives, Homebrew tap | nothing — exactly as now |
| `desktop-v0.5.2` | macOS, Linux and Windows installers | new path |

`desktop-v*` should reuse `release.yml`'s existing entrance pattern rather than adding a second implementation of publishing — that file already has one implementation and three entrances, and this is a fourth entrance, not a second copy.

A check refuses a `desktop-v*` naming a version no release carries, in the shape *Validate release label and changelog* already has. The app's `version` is stamped from the tag at build time so there is no second number kept in step by hand.

Open question from the decision task: whether this is one version or two. If two, this task changes shape — the desktop app keeps a number of its own and the check above becomes unnecessary.

## The updater feed moves, and nothing needs migrating

`electron-updater` reads `tylerkilgore/workbench` releases today; it would read this repository instead. That would normally strand every installed copy, which is a real cost — here it is not, because one person has it installed. No redirect release, no transition period.

Windows uses electron-updater's native flow. macOS deliberately does not: those builds carry an ad-hoc signature rather than a Developer ID one, and Squirrel.Mac silently refuses to install over a bundle it cannot verify, so `quitAndInstall` returns having done nothing while the user believes they upgraded. The Mac path downloads the DMG and opens it in Finder instead. That behaviour should come across unchanged.

## Last step

Archive `tylerkilgore/workbench` once a `desktop-v*` has been cut from here and verified to install.
